name: Roasted Acorn Squash (Fork-Tender Flesh, Seedless & Skinless)
whyItWorks: Golden acorn squash roasted until spoon-tender with a drizzle of pure maple syrup and cinnamon. Fibrous tough rind and seeds are completely avoided.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Halve squash and scrape out all stringy pulp and seeds. Roast cut-side down at 375°F for 35 minutes until tender. Scoop golden flesh out of rind with a spoon.
